purpose: Synthetic known-answer fixtures for validating proposed repair/restoration-plan feasibility and lifecycle-state separation.
normative_notice: Every input is synthetic. These are evaluator mechanics, not real inventory, capacity, safety, engineering, workforce, delivery or service evidence.
precedence: A proven hard contradiction makes plan_readiness=infeasible even when unrelated evidence is missing.
When no hard contradiction is proven, any missing or insufficient required evidence makes plan_readiness=unknown.
plan_readiness=feasible does not imply work execution, inspection, commissioning or service restoration.
Only the continuity owner can establish service_state and stable restoration.
